lines: Why do you remember a TikTok from last week, but not your notes from yesterday?
Hi, I'm Uni! It's not because you're bad at studying.
One. A TikTok is short, and it's about one thing. Your brain can hold all of it at once.
Two. You see it and hear it at the same time. Two routes in, so it sticks better.
Three. You see the same trends again and again, days apart. That spacing is how memories last.
Four. You tell your friends about it. Pulling it back out of your head locks it in.
Now your final. A forty page chapter, read once, the night before.
Now your final. A 40-page chapter, read once, the night before.
Too much at once. Text only. No spacing. And nothing ever asks you to pull it back out.
So make your notes work like TikTok.
Unspool turns them into short reels. One idea each, with a voice, visuals, and a quiz.
